command:
set -u
printf 'HOST='; hostname
printf '
BINARIES
'; for x in caddy nginx apache2 cloudflared tailscale traefik; do p=$(command -v "$x" 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$p" ] && echo "$x=$p"; done
printf '
LISTENERS
'; ss -lnt 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,60p'
printf '
UNITS
'; systemctl --user --no-pager --type=service --state=running 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'caddy|nginx|cloudflared|tailscale|traefik|frankenstein|omega|bridge' | head -40 || true
